Hi {!Contact.Name},
Per our Terms of Service, wholesale accounts that have not placed an order in 18 months are subject to deactivation. Your account, {!Shopify_At_Risk_Notice__c.Store_Name__c}, has not ordered since {!Shopify_At_Risk_Notice__c.Last_Order_Date_At_Notice__c}, which puts you approaching that window.
To keep your account active, simply place an order any time before {!Shopify_At_Risk_Notice__c.Deactivation_Date__c}. If you have questions about products, pricing, or your account, reply to this email or reach out to your account representative.
Best,
The goodr wholesale team
